flashcard_questions.q: What three factors determine material selection?

flashcard_questions.a: The acceptable range of variation in a dimension, expressed as a plus/minus figure (e.g., ±2 mm).
Arranging parts as closely together as possible on a sheet of material before cutting, to minimise waste.
A fixed point, line, or surface from which all other measurements are taken to ensure consistency.
The width of material removed by a cutting tool such as a saw blade, which must be accounted for in measurements.
